'''Kotono Mitsuishi''' (Japanese: '''三石琴乃''' ''Mitsuishi Kotono'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Mitsuishi was born on December 8, 1967, in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and she became a voice actress as an adult. She first started her work in {{aniseries|OS}}. Her first role was that of [[Duplica's Ditto]], and she later provided the voice of all {{p|Azumarill}} that appeared in the show. Her most major human role was that of [[Domino]] in ''[[Mewtwo Returns]]''.
